rationale: The ATMS complexity bound O(p*a) is a specific formal instance of the general meta-principle that all inference is resource-bounded. The meta-principle identifies finite time and computational budgets as universal constraints on reasoning; the ATMS result quantifies one such constraint for a particular assumption-based truth maintenance algorithm.
